_comment: Fixture variables for standalone rendering of card.dart.jinja2 AND card.html.jinja2 (serves both output legs). widget_class_name is the generated class name; file_stem is the lower-snake-case filename stem used to derive the cubit/state import paths; card_variant seeds the default variant (elevated/outlined/filled). The html-only keys (has_header/header_title, has_body/body_content, has_actions/action_labels) drive the card.html.jinja2 branches; action_labels takes the multi-button path so the singular action_label stays unset, matching the v1.0 oracle render.
